TEA_MASTER.pages.BEAT_HIS_ASS.descriptio:
Without warning, you punch the [blue]Tea Master[/blue] in the face.

[jitter][b]“Young people have no honor...”[/b][/jitter]

He staggers back, holds his cheek in silence, then presses both [gold]Bone Tea[/gold] and [gold]Ember Tea[/gold] into your hands.
BUGSLAYER.pages.DONE.description: Silently the figure nods at you, and then walks away.
BUGSLAYER.pages.EXTERMINATION.descriptio:
“I see... you wish to learn the [gold]Extermination Technique[/gold]. Very good...”

He pauses briefly, thinking how best to endow you with this maneuver...

[jitter]“THIS IS THE TECHNIQUE! BEHOLD!!”[/jitter]
He boasts while holding up a can of [green]Insecticide[/green].
BUGSLAYER.pages.INITIAL.description:
As you fend off a [jitter][red]swarm of vicious insects[/red][/jitter], you suddenly notice a [gold]mighty, rugged warrior[/gold] who has been fighting beside you all along!

Sensing defeat, the insects scatter. You turn to your fellow fighter.
“Would you like some advice on exterminating these pests?”
BUGSLAYER.pages.INITIAL.options.EXTERMIN: Choose a card and transform it into [gold]{Card1}[/gold].
There are no cards that can be transformed.
BUGSLAYER.pages.INITIAL.options.SQUASH.d: Choose a card and transform it into [gold]{Card2}[/gold].
BUGSLAYER.pages.INITIAL.options.SQUASH_L: There are no cards that can be transformed.
BUGSLAYER.pages.REFUSE.description:
You refuse the warrior's advice and decide to deal with the pests yourself.
These plump insects should fetch a decent price.
BUGSLAYER.pages.SQUASH.description:
“I see... you wish to learn the [gold]Squash Technique[/gold]. Very good...”

He pauses briefly, thinking how best to endow you with this maneuver...

[jitter]“THIS IS THE TECHNIQUE! BEHOLD!!”[/jitter]
He boasts while stepping on a giant bug.
BUGSLAYER.title: Bugslayer
SLIPPERY_BRIDGE.pages.INITIAL.options.OV: Choose [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] to remove.
There are no cards that can be removed.
SLIPPERY_BRIDGE.pages.HOLD_ON_ENDFIX.des: You endure the storm and reach the other side.
SLIPPERY_BRIDGE.pages.INITIAL.options.HO: Lose [red]15[/red] HP. Choose [blue]2[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold] to remove.
There are not enough removable cards (2 required).
SLIPPERY_BRIDGE.pages.RETURN_NOW.descrip: You turn back and find somewhere safe to rest.
INFESTED_AUTOMATON.pages.INITIAL.options: Obtain a card reward containing only [gold]Power cards[/gold].
Obtain a card reward containing only cards that [gold]cost 0[/gold].
INFESTED_AUTOMATON.pages.INITIAL.descrip:
This hidden chamber is filled with [red]decommissioned automatons[/red].

One machine stands alone, its [sine][aqua]core still glowing faintly[/aqua][/sine], but strange organic growth has consumed it and left it unresponsive.
INFESTED_AUTOMATON.pages.STUDY.descripti:
By studying the [aqua]glowing automaton[/aqua] and its internal structure, you realize that certain arrangements of metal can withstand all manner of afflictions!

You apply this [blue]technology[/blue] to yourself.
INFESTED_AUTOMATON.pages.TOUCH_CORE.desc:
The instant you touch the [aqua]core[/aqua], a violent [jitter][gold]current surges through you[/gold][/jitter].

You stagger back, sensing that the encounter has caused some strange [sine][purple]change[/purple][/sine] within you.
INFESTED_AUTOMATON.title: Infested Automaton
HUNGRY_FOR_MUSHROOMS.pages.EAT_ALL.descr:
Without hesitation, you devour every mushroom.

[sine]They are delicious... and you sink into a [red]post-meal stupor[/red].[/sine]
Your gluttony will have consequences.
[jitter]So it was a carb crash...[/jitter]
HUNGRY_FOR_MUSHROOMS.pages.ENDURE_HUNGER:
You endure your hunger and resist the tempting mushrooms.

[jitter][b]“I cannot eat these!”[/b][/jitter]

You master your appetite, though a trace of regret remains.
HUNGRY_FOR_MUSHROOMS.pages.INITIAL.optio: There are no cards that can be upgraded.
REFLECTIONS.pages.INITIAL.options.CAUTIO: Choose a non-Quest card from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and obtain a [gold]copy[/gold] of it.
REFLECTIONS.pages.CAUTIOUS_PROBE.descrip:
Rather than touching the glass outright, you trace one finger along its frigid edge. Ripples spread across your reflection, and the outline of a card slowly rises from the darkness.

When the surface grows still, the card rests in your hand—[sine][aqua]identical to the original[/aqua][/sine].
REFLECTIONS.pages.LEAVE.description:
Your reflections continue watching in silence. You suppress your curiosity and turn away.

One final ripple passes through the glass before everything becomes [jitter][gray]still[/gray][/jitter].
THE_LEGENDS_WERE_TRUE.pages.STEAL_AND_SE:
While no one is looking, you roll up the [gold]treasure map[/gold] and slip it under your coat.

Whether the treasure is real no longer matters—a collector in town gladly pays [gold]Gold[/gold] for such an ‘authentic’ map.
TRASH_HEAP.pages.INITIAL.options.CHOOSE_: Gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold and choose one card from all [blue]legacy cards[/blue].
TRASH_HEAP.pages.RELIC_SELECTION.descrip:
Ignoring the pain, you burrow deeper into the heap, pushing aside rusted metal and rotten boards.

Several intact [gold]Relics[/gold] lie buried among the refuse, but you can carry only one.
TRASH_HEAP.pages.RELIC_SELECTION.options: View the other [gold]Relics[/gold] buried in the heap.
Return to the [gold]Relics[/gold] you found earlier.
TRASH_HEAP.pages.RELIC_SELECTED.descript: You pull the chosen [gold]Relic[/gold] free, wipe away the grime, and leave the heap satisfied.
TRASH_HEAP.pages.CARD_SELECTED.descripti:
You sift carefully through ruined machinery and mounds of wastepaper until you uncover a card from another age.

You pocket the [gold]Gold[/gold] and the card, leaving before the heap collapses around you.
TRASH_HEAP.pages.LEAVE.description:
The stench and the precarious mountain of refuse convince you to stop searching.

You turn away, leaving the forgotten debris behind.
RELIC_TRADER.pages.INITIAL.options.TRADE: View the [gold]trades[/gold] offered by the Relic Trader.
RELIC_TRADER.pages.INITIAL.options.REROL: Reroll both the [gold]offered[/gold] and requested Relics.
RELIC_TRADER.pages.TRADING.description:
The Relic Trader spreads out his wares and invites you to choose a trade.

Each new Relic is marked with the [gold]Relic[/gold] he expects in return.
RELIC_TRADER.pages.LEAVE.description:
You decline the Relic Trader's offer.

Before he can present any more wares, you secure your Relics and walk away.
WELCOME_TO_WONGOS.pages.FREE_SHOPPING.de:
You glance around and find every clerk distracted by another customer.

In one swift motion, you pocket two [blue]Common Relics[/blue] and stroll casually out of the store.

[jitter][gold]Total spent: 0 Gold.[/gold][/jitter]
TRIAL.pages.RUN_AWAY.description:
While every eye is fixed on the tribunal, you quietly slip into the crowd.

By the time the horns sound again, you are already beyond the [gold]golden archway[/gold], leaving the noisy trial far behind.
ZEN_WEAVER.pages.TEAR_WEB.description:
Ignoring the weaver's teachings, you seize a nearby web and tear it apart.

Coins hidden among the strands scatter across the floor. You collect [gold]100 Gold[/gold] and leave before the weaver can react.
PUNCH_OFF.pages.INITIAL.options.SNEAK_AT: Obtain a reward set containing a [gold]Potion[/gold], [gold]Gold[/gold], and a [gold]Card Reward[/gold].
PUNCH_OFF.pages.SNEAK_ATTACK.description:
While both fighters are focused on each other's fists, you strike from the side and seize every prize within reach.

By the time they realize what happened, you have vanished into the crowd with the [gold]Potion, Gold, and Cards[/gold].
THE_FUTURE_OF_POTIONS.pages.LEAVE.descri: You decide not to test these visions of Potions' future on yourself and leave the experiment behind.
THIS_OR_THAT.pages.LEAVE.description: You refuse to choose between the two, leave them where they are, and continue onward.
ROOM_FULL_OF_CHEESE.pages.INITIAL.option: Do not touch the cheese and [blue]leave[/blue].
ROOM_FULL_OF_CHEESE.pages.LEAVE.descript: The overpowering smell keeps you cautious. Covering your nose, you quickly retreat from the room.
Stay away from the Brain Leech and [blue]leave[/blue].
BRAIN_LEECH.pages.LEAVE.description: You refuse to approach the writhing Brain Leech and depart before it can reach your thoughts.
WHISPERING_HOLLOW.pages.LEAVE.descriptio: You do not answer the hollow's whispers. The voices fade into the darkness behind you.
LUMINOUS_CHOIR.pages.INITIAL.options.LEA: Keep away from the Choir and [blue]leave[/blue].
LUMINOUS_CHOIR.pages.LEAVE.description: You avoid the cold radiance and overlapping voices, following the quiet path away.
MORPHIC_GROVE.pages.INITIAL.options.LEAV: Do not enter the Grove and [blue]leave[/blue].
MORPHIC_GROVE.pages.LEAVE.description: Shapes continue shifting within the Grove. Rather than enter, you make your way around the strange place.
UNREST_SITE.pages.LEAVE.description: There is no rest to be found here. You move on in search of a safer path.
WOOD_CARVINGS.pages.INITIAL.options.LEAV: Do not touch the carvings and [blue]leave[/blue].
WOOD_CARVINGS.pages.LEAVE.description: You touch none of the wooden carvings. They watch in silence as you depart.
CRYSTAL_SPHERE.pages.INITIAL.options.LEA: Do not peer into the Crystal Sphere; [blue]leave[/blue].
CRYSTAL_SPHERE.pages.LEAVE.description: You look away, refusing to let the visions within the Crystal Sphere decide your path.
STONE_OF_ALL_TIME.pages.LEAVE.descriptio: The Stone of All Time remains unmoved. You abandon the challenge and conserve your strength for the road ahead.
FIELD_OF_MAN_SIZED_HOLES.pages.LEAVE.des: You enter none of the man-sized holes, carefully making your way around the field instead.
SPIRIT_GRAFTER.pages.LEAVE.description:
You keep clear of the restless spirits, refusing to let any foreign presence enter your body.

Their whispers fade behind you as you leave unharmed.
ROUND_TEA_PARTY.pages.LEAVE.description:
You offer the figures around the round table a polite nod, but do not take a seat.

Before the scent of tea and renewed arguments can surround you, you turn away from the peculiar gathering.
RANWID_THE_ELDER.pages.LEAVE.description:
You politely refuse Ranwid's proposal and secure your belongings.

The elder nods thoughtfully and watches you depart in silence.
DENSE_VEGETATION.pages.LEAVE.description:
Rather than push deeper into the suffocating foliage, you carefully retrace your steps.

The rustling vegetation soon falls behind as you find a safer path.
